items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Diz sent for me to join the band. I joined them in San Francisco, and I stayed with them for about two years... I was watching Dizzy Gillespie, who was in front of the band

ctx.x: And Diz sent for me to join the band. I joined them in San Francisco, and I stayed with them for about two years, and I returned to Detroit in ’50.

So you um, going back to your, your education metaphor, it’s clear that, as you stated earlier there’s uh, education, let’s call it a book with many chapters, and, and you mentioned earlier playing every day, comparing that to say an author. What kinds of things did uh...did you play? Were they popular tunes? Were they pieces you were, you were writing, or other, maybe all the above?
